items.title: Q&A: How Everstone Brings Where Winds Meet to Life with NVIDIA DLSS 5
items.excerpt: Everstone Studio explains how it integrated DLSS 5 neural rendering into the wuxia open world Where Winds Meet to push more realistic lighting and materials across landscapes and characters.

items.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 Costs Red Dead Redemption 2 31% of Its 4K Performance, Yet It Almost Turns the Game Into A Movie With Natural Lighting
items.excerpt: A comparison of RDR2 with DLSS 5 neural rendering shows a single pass beats a double pass for lighting and character fidelity, at a 31% 4K frame-rate cost on an RTX 5080.

items.title: KRAFTON Officially Launches In-House LLM 'Raon-1 mini'
items.excerpt: KRAFTON released the full version of Raon-1 mini, its self-developed 30B-parameter MoE language model (about 4B active), free on Hugging Face with adjustable reasoning levels.

items.title: 크래프톤·시프트업이 만든 AI, 성적표로 말하다
items.excerpt: 크래프톤은 직접 학습시킨 언어모델 정식 버전을 내놨고, 시프트업은 국제 기계번역 대회에서 아마존·삼성전자·화웨이 등과 겨뤄 최상위 그룹에 올랐다.

items.title: 시프트업, 국제 기계번역 대회 WMT 2026에서 최상위 그룹 선정
items.excerpt: 시프트업의 자체 개발 AI 번역 시스템이 WMT 2026 기계번역 대회에서 최상위 그룹에 선정됐다. 게임 현지화용 번역 기술이다.

items.title: AI 시대, 중요성 커진 창의력…넥슨은 어떻게 창작 역량 쌓을까
items.excerpt: 넥슨이 사내 창의 프로그램 '크리에이티브 어택'을 열고 사내 AX 경진대회 '넥커톤' 본선 피칭데이에서 AI로 만든 결과물을 선보였다.

items.title: Resident Evil Creator Wishes AI Would 'Vanish Entirely,' Fearing Mass Job Losses
items.excerpt: At a G-CON 2026 panel, Shinji Mikami and Stellar Blade's Kim Hyung-tae laid out opposing views on AI in game development, with Mikami fearing mass job losses.

items.title: Fed up of Steam's lack of action regarding AI slop? Maybe you should take a look at the 'Games Without AI' event, instead
items.excerpt: After Steam Next Fest drew criticism for AI slop, a third-party 'Games Without AI' Steam event showcases 96 indie titles whose developers attest they were made without generative AI.

items.title: We are already in a world where gen-AI is pushing people to promote games as human-made, Citizen Sleeper creator says
items.excerpt: Citizen Sleeper creator Gareth Damian Martin says gen-AI adoption is spreading so widely that 'human-made' is becoming a marketing position for games.

items.title: Unity Asset Store and CLI: Let Your AI Agent Find and Add Assets
items.excerpt: The Unity CLI and Asset Store let coding agents search the store, pull single prefabs from packs, and generate missing assets with 60+ AI models.

items.title: Unity and AI: What to vibe code and where to rely on infrastructure
items.excerpt: Unity outlines where AI-assisted development with the Unity CLI helps on prototypes and UI, and where teams should rely on managed infrastructure for CAD, security and scale.

items.title: 韓国最大級ゲームショウのメインスポンサーはAIキャラチャットの「Crack」。日本版「キャラぷ」の日本法人代表に話を聞く［G-STAR 2026］
items.excerpt: G-STAR 2026で非ゲーム企業として初めてメインスポンサーを務めたAIキャラクターチャット「Crack」。日本版「キャラぷ」の代表にクリエイター還元や運営方針を聞いた。

items.title: AI girlfriends based on Lucia from GTA 6 are making creators thousands
items.excerpt: GTA 6's Lucia has inspired a wave of AI-generated girlfriend characters, with some creators claiming they make tens of thousands of dollars a month.

items.title: Rogue Duck Interactive's Dora Özsoy on AI, Steam discoverability, and the future of indie games
items.excerpt: Following its Mobidictum Conference 2026 Indie Awards win, Rogue Duck Interactive's founder discusses how the studio uses AI and how it affects Steam discoverability for indies.

items.title: Reports of AI psychosis at Ubisoft are good news to Epic CEO Tim Sweeney, who says "the future of French game development is at stake"
items.excerpt: Tim Sweeney backs Ubisoft's reported AI-first push, arguing gen AI productivity gains would let games hit a higher quality bar faster; French indie studios push back.

items.title: Former Nintendo of America boss apologizes to the "haters" of his AI slop posting: "It made me smile"
items.excerpt: Doug Bowser deleted an AI-generated Thanksgiving image of himself with Bowser and Donkey Kong after backlash, then apologized to the 'haters'.

items.title: AI 캐디와 대화하며 즐기는 스크린 골프...프라임파크골프 출시
items.excerpt: 프라임파크돔이 음성으로 대화하는 AI 캐디를 넣은 스크린골프 '프라임파크골프'를 출시했다. 남은 거리·그린 경사를 음성으로 안내한다.

items.title: AI와 디지털자산이 미치는 영향, 한국게임학회 세션 개최
items.excerpt: 한국게임학회 디지털자산분과가 12월 4~5일 추계학술발표대회에서 'AI 이후, 산업과 사람의 재정의'를 주제로 AI·디지털자산·게임 융합 세션을 연다.

items.title: GTA 6's pirate PC ports: new tools, old problem | Opinion
items.excerpt: Take-Two can play whack-a-mole on GitHub, but ubiquitous AI coding tools mean recompiled games are a genie that won't go back in the bottle.

items.title: "Game feel is impossible to copy": CEO of Probably Stolen publisher tinyBuild says devs "shouldn't be afraid" of AI clones
items.excerpt: tinyBuild's CEO argues AI-made clones can copy a game's look but not its game feel, so developers shouldn't fear them.

items.title: Letter from the Editor(s) #21: That game everyone is and isn't playing, and how we report on AI
items.excerpt: RPS's editors set out how the site will report on generative AI in games going forward.

items.title: Unreal MCP Terminal Plugin: Use Your AI Agent Without Leaving Unreal
items.excerpt: Epic shows how to enable the Terminal plugin and run an AI coding agent with Unreal MCP inside the editor, keeping agent and project in one workflow.
